title: A Trip to the Beach
text:
Maria likes to travel. Every summer, she takes a train to the beach. The train is fast and comfortable. She sits by the window and looks at the green fields.

Sometimes she goes by bus too. The bus stop is near her house. Maria buys her ticket at the station before she gets on. She always arrives on time.

questions.text: What does Maria take to the beach every summer?
Where does Maria buy her ticket?
Why does Maria probably like the train?
What kind of person is Maria most likely?

vocabulary.definition: pleasant and easy to feel good in
a place where trains or buses stop
a paper or card that allows you to travel

paragraph_translations: Maria gosta de viajar. Todo verão, ela pega um trem para a praia. O trem é rápido e confortável. Ela senta perto da janela e olha para os campos verdes.
Às vezes ela também vai de ônibus. O ponto de ônibus fica perto da casa dela. Maria compra o bilhete na estação antes de subir. Ela sempre chega na hora.
